title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MUNGWARAKARAMA
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MUNGWARAKARAMA
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00519/2023/CA (Mukandamage, J. P.) 08 Mutarama
2026]
Amategeko agenga ibimenyetso – Imanza nshinjabyaha – Ibimenyetso mu manza nshinjabyaha – Mu
manza nshinjabyaha, ibimenyetso byose bishobora gushingirwaho mu gihe bigaragaza ukuri
kw’ibyabaye, ababuranyi bakaba barahawe uburyo bwo kuhaba ngo banyomozanye, kandi ko urukiko
arirwo rwemeza ko ibyo bimenyetso bishobora kwemerwa.
Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize y’imanza nshinjabyaha – Itangwa ry’indishyi mu manza
nshinjabyaha – Amafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza n’ay’igihembo cy Avoka – Umuburanyi watsinzwe
niwe utegekwa kwishyura undi amafaranga yakoreshejwe akurikirana urubanza, ndetse n’igihembo
cyahawe Avoka kugira ngo amuburanire cyangwa amwunganire.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Mungwarakarama yarezwe mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Rubavu icyaha cyo
gusambanya umwana w’imyaka icumi, Ubushinjacyaha bumusabira guhamwa n’icyo cyaha agahanishwa
igihano cyo gufungwa burundu. Uhagarariye umwana yatanze ikirego cy’indishyi yisunze
Ubushinjacyaha, asaba ko Uregwa amwishyura indishyi z’akababaro n’iz’impozamarira, kuko umwana
yagizweho ingaruka n’icyaha yakorewe. Uregwa yaburanye ahakana icyaha avuga ko ari akagambane
yagiriwe, kuko umwana yabwirijwe kumushinja, aho yaranzwe no guhindagura amatariki y’igihe icyaha
cyakorewe, ndetse avuga ko nta ndishyi yatanga kuko nta cyaha yakoze.
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwaciye urubanza rushingiye ku bimenyetso bitandukanye, rwemeza ko Uregwa
ahamwa n’icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, rumuhanisha igifungo cya burundu ndetse rumutegeka no
kwishyura indishyi zisabwa mu rubanza.
Uregwa yajuriye bwa mbere mu Rukiko Rukuru, urugereko rwa Musanze avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha cyo
gusambanya umwana ntacyo yakoze, ko iyo asambanya umwana yari kumwanduza agakoko gatera SIDA
kuko abana n’ubwo bwandu, kandi ko hari ugushidikanya ku myaka y’umwana aregwa gusambanya,
asaba kurenganurwa. Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ubwo bujurire bw’Uregwa buvuga ko butahabwa
ishingiro, kuko atabashije kuvuguruza ibimenyetso byose byashingiweho.
Urukiko Rukuru rwasanze ubujurire bw’Uregwa nta shingiro bufite, rwemeza ko nta gihindutse ku
rubanza yajuririye rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Rubavu. Iki cyemezo Uregwa yakijuririye ku
rwego rw kabiri muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire asaba kugirwa umwere.
Muri uru rubanza, Uregwa asobanura ko ibimenyetso byashingiweho mu kumuhamya icyaha aregwa
bishidikanywaho bigizwe n’ubuhamya bwatanzwe na raporo ya Muganga. Avuga ko hari ikibazo cyo
kuba abamurega baratinze gutanga amakuru, kuko bavuga ko umwana yahohotewe ku wa 23/09/2019,
ababimenye bagatanga ikirego kuri 25/09/2019, Ubuyobozi bukabimenyeshwa ku wa 26/09/2019,
ntanavuge ko yagejeje ikirego kuri RIB ahubwo bakamwoherezayo, hanyuma agafatwa ku wa 28/09/2019
kandi bataramubuze, kuko atigeze ava mu rugo. Ngo ibi byose bihujwe n’amakimbirane bafitanye
bigaragara ko ibyo aregwa ari ibihimbano. Avuga kandi ko raporo ya Muganga irimo gushidikanya, kuko
ivuga ko akarangabusugi k’umwana gafite ibice bitavuyeho kandi havamo amaraso, hakaba hakwibazwa
ukuntu umwana w’imyaka 10 yasambanywa n’umugabo ntamwangize bikomeye, bityo bikaba
byumvikana ko ntacyo yatwaye umwana.
Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko kuba Urukiko Rukuru rwarashingiye ku mvugo z’umwana wasambanyijwe
zitunganiwe n’ibindi bimenyetso nta shingiro byahabwa, kuko uretse n’izo mvugo rwanashingiye ku
buhamya bw’abandi bantu, hanashingirwa by’umwihariko kuri raporo ya Muganga yaragaraje ko umwana
yari afite ibimyenyetso ku gitsina by’uko yasambanyijwe. Buvuga ko iby’Uregwa avuga ko hari
ukuvuguruzanya kw’abatangabuhamya nta shingiro bifite, kuko kuba bataravuze amagambo ahura ijana
ku ijana mu gusobanura ibyo babazwaga, atari ikibazo kuko batabarijwe ahantu hamwe, ariko ko

amagambo yose ahuriza ku cyaha cyakozwe, uwagikoze, aho yagikoreye ndetse n’uwagikorewe. Buvuga
kandi ko ibyo Uregwa avuga ko raporo ya Muganga itagaragaza neza ko icyaha cyabayeho, kubera ijambo
“probable” ryakoreshejwe, ari ukuvuga ibintu uko bitari, kuko Muganga yaragaragaje uko umwana yari
yangijwe ku karangabusugi kandi bigaragara ko byari bimaze igihe gito bikozwe, nta gushidikanya ko
byahuraga n’ibisobanuro byatanzwe n’umwana by’uko yasambanyijwe. Bityo, Ubushinjacyaha bukaba
busaba ko hakwemezwa ko ubujurire bw’Uregwa nta shingiro bufite, hakagumaho imikirize y’urubanza
rujuririrwa.
Muri uru rubanza kandi hasuzumwe ikibazo kijyanye n’amafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza n’ay’igihembo
cya Avoka asabwa n’Uhagarariye umwana wasambanyijwe, aho avuga ko ku ndishyi yari yagenewe
n’inkiko zabanje hakwiyongeraho amafaranga yo gukurikirana urubanza n’ay’igihembo cya Avoka
kubera ko Uregwa akomeje kumusiragiza mu nkiko. Uregwa yisobanuye avuga ko ayo mafaranga asabwa
nta shingiro afite, kuko icyaha aregwa ntacyo yakoze, ahubwo asaba kugirwa umwere.
Incamake y’icyemezo: 1. Mu manza nshinjabyaha, ibimenyetso byose bishobora gushingirwaho mu gihe
bigaragaza ukuri kw’ibyabaye, ababuranyi bakaba barahawe uburyo bwo kuhaba ngo banyomozanye,
kandi ko urukiko arirwo rwemeza ko ibyo bimenyetso bishobora kwemerwa.
2. Umuburanyi watsinzwe niwe utegekwa kwishyura undi amafaranga yakoreshejwe akurikirana
urubanza, ndetse n’igihembo cyahawe Avoka kugira ngo amuburanire cyangwa amwunganire.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Ubujurire bwuririye k’ubundi bufite ishingiro kuri bimwe.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 062/2024 ryo ku wa 20/06/2024 rigenga ibimenyetso, ingingo ya 87.
Itegeko N° 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, nk’uko ryahinduwe,
ingingo ya 133.
Itegeko N° 15/2004 ryo ku wa 12/06/2004 ryerekeye ibimenyetso mu manza n’itangwa ryabyo, ingingo
ya 119.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA0118/11/CS, Ubushinjacyaha v. Ngurinzira, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa 13/11/2015.
RPAA/GEN00006/2022/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. 2Lt Henri Jean Claude Seyoboka rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 28/11/2025.
RPAA00279/2025/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Munyarugamba Emmanuel rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire
ku wa 24/10/2025.
RPAA00581/2021/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Pte Ntawuhiganayo Narcisse na CHUB rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 30/01/2024.
RPAA00692/2021/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Ndayishimiye Jean Damascène rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/01/2023.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Mungwarakarama Abdou bakunze kwita Muzehe yacyetsweho ko ku wa 23/09/2019 yagiye mu
rugo rwa Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc, asanga umwana witwa I. D.1 w’imyaka 10 y’amavuko uharererwa
1 Amazina arahinwe kubera kamere y’icyaha n’imyaka y’uwahohotewe.

yicaye mu gikoni n’abana 2 bato, asohora abo bana arafunga aramusambanya, atatse amutera ubwoba ko
amutemesha umuhoro yari afite.
[2] Nyuma y’iperereza, Ubushinjacyaha bwareze Mungwarakarama Abdou mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye
rwa Rubavu icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, busaba ko ahamwa n’icyo cyaha agahanishwa igifungo cya
burundu.
[3] Habanabakize Thomas, uhagarariye umwana we I.D. yatanze ikirego cy’indishyi yisunze
Ubushinjacyaha, asaba ko Mungwarakarama Abdou yamwishyura indishyi z’akababaro zingana na
8.000.000Frw, indishyi z’impozamarira zingana na 3.000.000Frw, kubera ko umwana yagizweho
ingaruka n’icyaha yakorewe, na 88.450Frw y’ikurikiranarubanza.
[4] Mungwarakarama Abdou yaburanye ahakana icyaha aregwa, avuga ko yagiriwe akagambane na
Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc afatanyije n’umugabo Sebakara Juvénal babwiriza umwana kumushinja,
kuko yaranzwe no guhindagura amatariki y’igihe icyaha cyakorewe. Ku kirego cy’indishyi,
Mungwarakarama Abdou yavuze ko ntazo yatanga, kuko nta cyaha yakoze.
[5] Mu rubanza RP00623/2019/TGI/RBV rwaciwe ku wa 12/02/2021, Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa
Rubavu rwasanze Mungwarakarama Abdou ahamwa n’icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, rumuhanisha
igifungo cya burundu, rushingiye ku bimenyetso bikurikira:
a) imvugo z’umwana umushinja;
b) raporo ya Muganga igaragaza ko umwana yasambanyijwe;
c) imvugo za Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc wavuze ko Mungwarakarama Abdou asanzwe afite
imyitwarire itari myiza.
Urukiko rwategetse Mungwarakarama Abdou kwishyura Habanabakize Thomas 3.000.000Frw y’indishyi
z’akababaro, 2.000.000Frw y’indishyi z’impozamarira no kumusubiza ingwate y’amagarama yatanze
arega.
[6] Mungwarakarama Abdou yajuririye Urukiko Rukuru, Urugereko rwa Musanze avuga ko
yahamijwe icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana ntacyo yakoze, ko iyo asambanya umwana yari kumwanduza
agakoko gatera SIDA kuko abana n’ubwo bwandu, kandi ko hari ugushidikanya ku myaka y’umwana
aregwa gusambanya, asaba kurenganurwa. Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha yavuze ko ubujurire bwa
Mungwarakarama Abdou butahabwa ishingiro, kuko atabashije kuvuguruza ibimenyetso byose
byashingiweho n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Rubavu.
[7] Mu rubanza RPA00257/2021/HC/MUS rwaciwe ku wa 23/11/2023, Urukiko Rukuru, Urugereko
rwa Musanze rwasanze ubujurire bwa Mungwarakarama Abdou nta shingiro bufite, rwemeza ko nta
gihindutse ku rubanza yajuririye. Rwasanze kandi amafaranga 200.000 y’indishyi Habanabakize Thomas
asaba kubera gukomeza gushorwa mu manza atayahabwa, kubera ko amafaranga 5.000.000 y’indishyi
yagenewe ku rwego rwa mbere ahagije.
[8] Mungwarakarama Abdou yajuririye Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, urubanza ruhabwa
RPAA00519/2023/CA. Iburanisha mu ruhame ryabaye ku wa 03/12/2025, Mungwarakarama Abdou
yunganiwe na Me Uwimabera Béata, Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Sibomana Stanislas,
Umushinjacyaha ku rwego rw’Igihugu, naho Habanabakize Thomas yunganiwe na Me Muhozi Paulin.
[9] Mu myanzuro no mu miburanire, Mungwarakarama Abdou avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha cyo
gusambanya umwana hashingiwe ku bimenyetso bishidikanywaho, agasaba kugirwa umwere.
Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko inzitizi yo kutakira ingingo z’ubujurire zatanzwe na
Mungwarakarama Abdou bwari bwatanze ayiretse, naho mu mizi y’urubanza akavuga ko

Mungwarakarama Abdou atabasha kuvuguruza ibimenyetso byashingiweho n’Urukiko Rukuru,
Urugereko rwa Musanze rumuhamya icyaha, ko rero ubujurire bwe nta shingiro bufite.
[10] Habanabakize Thomas avuga ko ku ndishyi Mungwarakarama Abdou yategetswe kumwishyura
hakwiyongeraho amafaranga yo gukurikirana urubanza kuko akomeje kumusiragiza mu manza,
umwunganira akavuga ko yahabwa n’ay’igihembo cya Avoka. Mungwarakarama Abdou avuga ko ayo
amafaranga asabwa ntayo agomba gutanga, kuko nta cyaha yakoze.
[11] Muri uru rubanza harasuzumwa ibibazo bikurikira:
1) kumenya niba Mungwarakarama Abdou yarahamijwe icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana
hashingiwe ku bimenyetso bishidikanywaho;
2) kumenya niba indishyi Mungwarakarama Abdou yategetswe kwishyura Habanabakize Thomas
zakwiyongera.
I. ISESENGURWA RY’IBIBAZO BIGIZE URUBANZA
1) Kumenya niba Mungwarakarama Abdou yarahamijwe icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana
hashingiwe ku bimenyetso bishidikanywaho
[12] Mungwarakarama Abdou na Me Uwimabera Béata umwunganira bavuga ko yahamijwe icyaha
cyo gusambanya umwana hashingiwe ku bimenyetso bishidikanywaho bigizwe n’ubuhamya bwatanzwe
na raporo ya Muganga.
[13] Ku byerekeye ubuhamya, Mungwarakarama Abdou na Me Uwimabera Béata bavuga ko
ubuhamya bw’umwana buvuguruzanya n’ubwa Nikuze Florence hamwe n’ubwa Uwuzuyinema Jeanne
d’Arc mu buryo bukurikira:
a) umwana I. D. bivugwa ko yahohotewe avuga ko Mungwarakarama Abdou yabanje kumusoma
aragenda, aza kongera kugaruka, abona kumusambanya;
b) Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc we avuga ko yamenye ko umwana yasambanyijwe abibwiwe na
Nikuze Florence nawe wabibwiwe n’umwana I. D., nyamara mu batangabuhamya ntavugamo
Nikuze Florence2;
c) Nikuze Florence avuga ko yumvise umwana I. D. mu gikoni avuga ngo arimo kwibabarira,
kandi ko yaba yarabonye Mungwarakarama Abdou asesera mu gipangu, hakaba hakwibazwa
impamvu atihutiye kubigeza kuri Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’arc, kandi bivugwa ko hari hasanzwe
amakimbirane hagati yabo.
[14] Mungwarakarama Abdou na Me Uwimabera Béata umwunganira bavuga ko hari ikibazo cyo kuba
abamurega baratinze gutanga amakuru, kuko bavuga ko umwana yahohotewe ku wa 23/09/2019 kandi
uwabyumvise bikiba ari Nikuze Florence usanzwe azi ko Mungwarakarama Abdou afitanye
amakimbirane na Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc kuko yigeze kumukubita nk’uko uyu yabivuze, ndetse na
Nikuze Florence akabigarukaho mu ibazwa rye, bakaba rero bibaza icyatumye Uwuzuyinema Jeanne
d’Arc amenya ko umwana yasambanyijwe ku wa 24/09/2019 bakajya gutanga ikirego ku wa 25/09/2019,
Ubuyobozi bukabimenyeshwa ku wa 26/09/2019, ntanavuge ko yagejeje ikirego kuri RIB ahubwo
bakamwoherezayo, hanyuma Mungwarakarama Abdou agafatwa ku wa 28/09/2019 kandi bataramubuze,
kuko atigeze ava mu rugo. Basanga ibyo byose bihujwe n’amakimbirane bafitanye bigaragara ko ibyo
Mungwarakarama Abdou aregwa ari ibihimbano. Kuba rero Urukiko Rukuru rwaravuze ko ayo
makimbirane ari amatakirangoyi atayagaragariza ibimenyetso, bakabona ko nta kindi kimenyetso babona
uretse imvugo zabo.
2 Reba ibazwa rya Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc muri RIB, ikibazo cya 6 (Q6) n’igisubizo cya 6 (R6).

[15] Mungwarakarama Abdou na Me Uwimabera Béata bavuga na none ko raporo ya Muganga irimo
gushidikanya, kuko ivuga ko akarangabusugi k’umwana gafite ibice bitavuyeho kandi havamo amaraso3,
igasoza ivuga ko hari “…probable rapport sexuel avec pénétration”, bikaba rero bitera kwibaza ukuntu
umwana w’imyaka 10 y’amavuko yasambanywa n’umugabo ntamwangize bikomeye, kuko ahantu henshi
muri iyo raporo hagaragara ko ibindi byose ari normal, nko kuri fourchette, perenium na anus,
byumvikana ko ntacyo Mungwarakarama Abdou yigeze atwara umwana.
[16] Mungwarakarama Abdou na Me Uwimabera Béata bavuga ndetse ko uwakoze iperereza hari
byinshi yirengagije kureba, kuko ku mwana usambanyijwe bwa mbere, hari no kwitabwa ku myenda yari
yambaye uwo munsi, kuko nubwo yari yakarabijwe, nta na hamwe havuzwe ko iyo myenda yameshwe,
hakanitabwa kubaza abana 2 bivugwa ko umwana I. D. yari kumwe nabo arimo kubagaburira. Bongeraho
ko mu isuzumwa ry’umwana Muganga atagaragaje ko hari amasohoro yabonye mu gitsina cy’umwana
ngo ahuzwe n’aye, bimenyekane ko ari we wamusambanyije.
[17] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko kuba Urukiko Rukuru, Urugereko rwa Rubavu
rwarashingiye ku mvugo z’umwana I. D. zitunganiwe n’ibindi bimenyetso nta shingiro byahabwa, kuko
uretse n’imvugo z’umwana wakorewe icyaha, rwanashingiye ku buhamya bw’abandi bantu,
hanashingirwa by’umwihariko kuri raporo ya Muganga yaragaraje ko umwana yari ifite ibimyenyetso ku
gitsina by’uko yasambanyijwe.
[18] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga kandi ko iby’uko hari ukuvuguruzanya kw’abatangabuhamya
ataribyo, kuko icyo bahurizaho ari uko I. D. yakorewe icyaha na Mungwarakarama Abdou, akaba
yaramusanze mu rugo, kandi nicyo cyaha yarezwe anagihamywa n’inkiko. Avuga ko kuba
abatangabuhamya bataravuze amagambo ahura ijana ku ijana mu gusobanura ibyo babazwaga, atari
ikibazo, kuko batabarijwe hamwe ngo bavuge bimwe, bakaba kandi bataravuze ibintu bakuye ahantu
hamwe, kuko buri wese yavuze aho yakuye amakuru mu buryo bwe, ariko kandi yose akaba ahuriza ku
cyaha cyakozwe, uwagikoze, aho yagikoreye ndetse n’uwagikorewe. Asanga rero ibyo abatangabuhamya
baba batarahurijeho bitatuma Mungwarakarama Abdou adahamwa n’icyaha.
[19] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga kandi ko imvugo z’abatangabuhamya zihabwa agaciro zimaze
gusesengurwa n’umucamanza, ibi bikaba byaratanzweho umurongo mu rubanza RPAA0118/11/CS
rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa 13/11/2015, haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Ngurinzira, uvuga ko
urukiko ari rwo rusuzuma ireme ry'ubuhamya rushingiye ku bumenyi bw'ababutanga n'uburyo basobanura
ibyo biboneye cyangwa bumvise, rukabigereranya n'ibindi bimenyetso.
[20] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga na none ko ibyo Mungwarakarama Abdou avuga ko raporo ya
Muganga itagaragaza neza ko icyaha cyabayeho, kubera ijambo “probable” ryakoreshejwe, ari ukuvuga
ibintu uko bitari, kuko Muganga yasuzumye umwana agaragaza ko yari yangijwe ku gitsina, aho
yakoresheje amagambo akurikira “Hymen perforé avec reste de vestige hyménial, saignement au contact
- probable rapport sexuel avec pénétration...”. Asanga rero kuba Muganga yaragaragaje uko umwana yari
yangijwe ku karangabusugi kandi bigaragara ko byari bimaze igihe gito bikozwe, nta gushidikanya ko
byahuraga n’ibisobanuro byatanzwe n’umwana by’uko yasambanyijwe, inshingano ze zikaba
zaragarukiraga mu gusuzuma umwana, naho kumenya impamvu n’uwabigizemo uruhare bikaba ari
inshingano y’inzego z’ubutabera, nk’uko byakozwe.
[21] Kubijyanye n’uko haba harirengagijwe amakimbirane Mungwarakarama Abdou yari afitanye
n’abo mu muryango w’umwana wakorewe icyaha, Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko mu gika cya 15
cy’urubanza rwajuririwe, urukiko rwagaragaje ko uretse kubivuga, nta bimenyetso yabitangiye. Naho
kubyo Mungurakarama Abdou avuga ko iperereza ritarakozwe neza nko kumva abana bari kumwe na I.
D. no gusuzuma imyenda umwana yari yambaye n’ibindi, avuga ko atagaragaza icyo anenga ibimenyetso
3 Hymen perforé avec reste de vestige hyménial, saignement au contact.

byagezweho n’Ubugenzacyaha, bigakorwa mu buryo bukurikije amategeko, kandi bigasuzumwa n’inzego
zibifitiye ububasha, Mungurakarama Abdou akaba atarigeze ashobora kubivuguruza mu nkiko zombi
yanyuzemo, ibyo bikaba bivuguruza kandi imvugo ye ko yahimbiwe icyaha. Asoza asaba ko hakwemeza
ko ubujurire bwe nta shingiro bufite, hakagumaho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe.
[22] Habanabakize Thomas na Me Muhozi Paulin umwunganira bavuga ko ubujurire bwa
Mungurakarama Abdou nta shingiro bufite, ahubwo agamije gukomeza guhakana icyaha kandi hari
ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko yagikoze.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[23] Impaka kuri iyi ngingo y’ubujurire zishingiye ku kumenya niba Mungwarakarama Abdou
yarahamijwe icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana w’imyaka 10 y’amavuko hashingiwe ku bimenyetso
bishidikanywaho.
[24] Kubyerekeranye n’ibimenyetso mu manza n’itangwa ryabyo, mu rubanza RPAA00692/2021/CA
rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/01/2023, haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Ndayishimiye Jean
Damascène, hasesenguwe ingingo ya 119 y’Itegeko N° 15/2004 ryo ku wa 12/06/2004 ryerekeye
ibimenyetso mu manza n’itangwa ryabyo4, harebwe cyane cyane ku mwihariko w’imanza nshinjabyaha,
maze urukiko rusobanura ko mu manza nshinjabyaha, ibimenyetso byose bishobora gushingirwaho mu
gihe bigaragaza ukuri kw’ibyabaye5, ababuranyi bakaba barahawe uburyo bwo kuhaba ngo
banyomozanye, kandi ko urukiko arirwo rwemeza ko ibyo bimenyetso bishobora kwemerwa. Iri hame
ryashingiweho mu zindi manza zakurikiyeho zaciwe n’uru rukiko, harimo n’urubanza

Mungwarakarama Abdou arimo gusesera mu gipangu ajya iwe, maze ageze mu rugo asanga umwana
arimo kurira, amubaza icyo yabaye yanga kumubwira, bigeze nimugoroba abibwira umukobwa babana,

nabivuga azamwica, hanyuma maman Myriade asiba akazi amujyana kwa Muganga.
[27] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga ibyo Mungwarakarama Abdou avuga ko hari ukuvuguruzanya
hagati y’imvugo z’umwana n’imvugo za Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’arc nta shingiro bifite, kuko ibimenyetso
byagarutsweho haruguru bigaragaza ko umwana I. D. yasambanyijwe ku wa 23/09/2019, hanyuma
abibwira Nikuze Florence, uyu nawe abwira Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc ko Mungwaramarama Abdou
yageze mu rugo agasambanya I. D. Ntabwo rero Mungwarakarama Abdou yavuga ko amakuru y’uko
umwana yasambanyijwe yatanzwe bitinze, kuko igihe Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc yabimenyeye yatanze
ikirego, n’umwana ajyanwa kwa Muganga, nawe abona ko yasambanyijwe nk’uko umwana yabivugaga.
[28] Kubyerekeye amakimbirane Mungwarakarama Abdou avuga ko afitanye na Uwuzuyinema Jeanne
d’Arc yatumye amurega amubeshyera ko yasambanyije umwana I. D., Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga
nta shingiro bifite, kubera ko ibyo umwana yavuze ko yamusambanyije akabibwira Nikuze Florence, uyu
nawe akabibwira Uwuzuyinema Jeanne d’Arc bishimangirwa na raporo ya Muganga yagaragaje ko
umwana yasambanyijwe, kuko akarangabusugi ke kwashanyaguritse, ku buryo mu gitsina havagamo
amaraso.
[29] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga na none ibyo Mungwarakarama Abdou avuga ko raporo ya
Muganga irimo gushidikanya nta shingiro bifite, kubera ko Muganga wasuzumye umwana yasanze
akarangabusugi kashwanyaguritse akoze ku gitsina abona havamo amaraso, yanzura ko umwana ashobora
kuba yasambanyijwe habayeho kwinjiza igitsina mu cye, bikaba rero byumvikana ko umwana
yasambanyijwe kandi yasambanyijwe na Mungwarakarama Abdou ashinja.
[30] Kubyo Mungwarakarama Abdou n’umwunganira bavuga ko hari ibyirengagijwe byari gufasha mu
kumenya niba koko ari we wasambanyije umwana, harimo gusuzuma imyenda umwana yari yambaye no
kuba hatararebwe niba hari amasohoro yari ku mwana I. D., Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga n’ubwo ibyo
bitakozwe, ntibyabuza ko ibindi bimenyetso byatanzwe n’Ubushinjacyaha bisuzumwa bigahabwa agaciro
bikwiye, kuko iyo haboneka ibindi bimenyetso nabyo byari guhuzwa n’ibindi byagezweho mu iperereza
bigashingirwaho mu kugaragaza ukuri ku cyaha Mungwarakarama Abdou yakoze. Naho kuba abana bari
kumwe n’uwasambanyijwe batarabajijwe, dosiye igaragaza ko bari bato cyane, kandi ko yabanje
kubasohora kugira ngo abone uko asambanya mugenzi wabo wabarutaga, bakaba rero ntacyo bamenye ku
mikorere y’icyaha.
[31] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga ibimenyetso byashingiweho n’Urukiko Rukuru, urugereko rwa
Musanze mu guhamya Mungwarakarama Abdou icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana byuzuzanya kandi
bidashidikanywaho, bityo ubujurire bwe nta shingiro bufite.
[32] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga rero urubanza RPA00257/2021/HC/MUS rwaciwe n’Urukiko
Rukuru, Urugereko rwa Musanze ku wa 23/11/2022 rugomba kugumaho ku bijyanye n’icyaha
Mungwarakarama Abdou yahamijwe cyo gusambanya umwana n’igihano yahawe cy’igifungo cya
burundu, cyane cyane ko gihwanye n’uburemere bw’icyaha yakoze cyo gusambanya umwana muto cyane
w’imyaka 10 akamwangiza nk’uko raporo ya Muganga ibigaragaza.
2) Ku byerekeye amafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza n’ay’igihembo cya Avoka asabwa na
Habanabakize Thomas

[33] Habanabakize Thomas na Me Muhozi Paulin umwunganira bavuga ko ku ndishyi yari yagenewe
n’inkiko zabanje hakwiyongeraho 300.000 Frw yo gukurikirana urubanza na 1.000.000Frw y’igihembo
cya Avoka kubera ko Mungwarakarama Abdou akomeje kumusiragiza mu nkiko.
[34] Mungwarakara Abdou na Me Uwimabera Béata bavuga ko amafaranga asabwa na Habanabakize
Thomas nta shingiro afite, kuko icyaha aregwa ntacyo yakoze, ahubwo asaba kugirwa umwere.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[35] Mu rubanza RPAA00581/2021/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 30/01/2024, haburana
Ubushinjacyaha na Pte Ntawuhiganayo Narcisse na CHUB, hasobanuwe ko umuburanyi watsinzwe ari
we utegekwa kwishyura undi amafaranga yakoreshejwe akurikirana urubanza, ndetse n’igihembo
cyahawe Avoka kugira ngo amuburanire cyangwa amwunganire. Uyu murongo washingiweho mu zindi
manza zaciwe n’uru rukiko harimo n’urubanza RPAA/GEN00006/2022/CA rwaciwe ku wa 28/11/2025,
Ubushinjacyaha buburana na 2Lt Henri Jean Claude Seyoboka.
[36] Nk’uko byasobanuwe haruguru, Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga ubujurire bwa Mungwarakarama
Abdou nta shingiro bufite, akaba rero agomba kwishyura Habanabakize Thomas 300.000Frw asaba yo
gukurikirana urubanza, kuko byabaye ngombwa ko akurikirana urubanza mu bujurire, kandi ayo
mafaranga asaba ari mu rugero rukwiye, harebwe ko yitabiriye iburanisha inshuro ebyiri anategura
imyanzuro.
[37] Urukiko rurasanga ariko 1.000.000Frw uwunganira Habanabakize Thomas asaba atayagenerwa,
kubera ko bigaragara mu myanzuro iri muri dosiye yakozwe n’uwo yunganira ko ntayo yasabye.
III. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[38] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwatanzwe na Mungwarakarama Abdou nta shingiro bufite.
[39] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwuririye ku bundi bwatanzwe na Habanabakize Thomas bufite ishingiro
kuri bimwe.
[40] Rutegetse ko igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu Mungwarakarama Abdou yahawe n’Urukiko
Rukuru, urugereko rwa Musanze ku cyaha cyo gusambanya umwana w’imyaka 10 kigumyeho.
[41] Rutegetse Mungwarakarama Abdou kwishyura Habanabakize Thomas 3.000.000Frw y’indishyi
z’akababaro, 2.000.000Frw y’indishyi z’impozamarira no kumusubiza ingwate y’amagarama yatanze
arega nk’uko yabitegetswe n’Urukiko Rukuru, urugereko rwa Musanze, na 300.000Frw
y’ikurikiranarubanza kuri uru rwego.
